{{Quote|The Backways, still scorched and broken where Master Ki-Adi-Mundi had fought infiltrators during the Clone Wars, were cleaned and rebuilt.|[[Oniye Namada]] in her [[I-1807-VAK|report]]|<ref name="TTF2">[[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 2|''Purge – The Tyrant's Fist'' 2]]</ref>}}
The '''Backways''' was a building on [[Vaklin]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Vaklin Zenith]]. It was scorched and destroyed when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] fought infiltrators there during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was cleaned and rebuilt by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] during the [[Vaklin insurgency]], in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], in order to erase all memory of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] legacy.
